02 / A LITTLE PERSPECTIVE

Every launch has a curve.

DAY 0 = RELEASE DATE

Align the same stretch of time around each release. Compare raw traffic or the change relative to a fixed pre-launch baseline.

Choose up to four of 20 releases at a time. Deselect a title to make room for another.

Select releases

View release-aligned data as a table

Index = 100 × daily views ÷ mean views on days −28 through −8. It is a retrospective comparison, not a forecasting feature. GTA V’s 2022 console release is a re-release; its article covers the entire game.

    04 / SHOW YOUR WORK

    The evidence is part of the project.

    01

    One honest signal.

    Daily pageviews from Wikimedia’s Analytics API, for exact English Wikipedia article titles. The “user” category excludes identified bots, but does not guarantee every request is human.

    Source & data license ↗
    02

    Past data stays in the past.

    Historical prediction tests use only observations before each target day. Release dates in the future remain unobserved. Missing observations and incomplete baselines stay unavailable.

    Read the fixed protocol ↗
    03

    Reproduce every number.

    Preserved source responses, checksummed receipts, and versioned analysis. No paid API or model inference. Downloads below use the exact same snapshot as these charts.

    Explore the repository ↗

    A BASELINE WORTH KEEPING

    Does smoothing help predict tomorrow?

    A retrospective test on a purposive cohort of 19 historical releases; not evidence of performance on GTA VI. WAPE is an error ratio, not accuracy.

    Data coverage, freshness & snapshot identity

    Daily refreshes are scheduled for 12:23 UTC. Failed acquisition retains the last good data. Scheduled jobs may be delayed; inspect observation dates and the publication history below.

    Article identity and title coverage audit

    Page creation and current redirects do not establish the historical canonical title on every date. Alias views are not merged. Inspect preserved audit evidence ↗
